outcome: Ovarian reserve (FSH, LH, E2, AMH, antral follicle count, ovarian volume)
cohort: 163 women who underwent cesarean section, 86 with tubal ligation and 77 without
finding: While ovarian reserve markers were largely similar between groups, tubal ligation during cesarean section was associated with increased frequency of menstrual irregularity (66.3%) and dysmenorrhea (47.7%).
